nodes.label: Concurrent TP/SL Closure Risk (P0-3)
nodes.rationale: The TP/SL close path has no CLOSING state, distributed lock, or atomic claim; two watcher instances or a manual click during a watcher cycle can sell the same position twice. select_for_update() alone is insufficient if the lock is held across the network call. Requires a single active watcher instance and an atomic OPEN->CLOSING claim before the external sell call.

nodes.label: Kraken Private POST Auto-Retry Risk (P0-2)
nodes.rationale: urllib3.Retry allows POST in allowed_methods, so non-idempotent Kraken calls like AddOrder/CancelOrder can be silently replayed after a 429/5xx or connection failure, turning an ambiguous order state into real financial risk. Requires disabling blind retries on non-idempotent commands, monotonic cross-process nonces, and using a client order id (userref) to look up/reconcile before retrying.

nodes.label: Persisted Order State Machine (P0-1)
nodes.rationale: Kraken order execution and local persistence are not atomic; a crash, exception, or retried request after a real Kraken fill can leave a live order unrecorded locally. Requires a persisted state machine (PENDING/SUBMITTED/OPEN/CLOSING/CLOSED/FAILED/RECONCILE_REQUIRED) with a client-generated idempotency id created before the external call, plus reconciliation against Kraken for ambiguous states.

nodes.label: Watcher Heartbeat Stored in Database
nodes.community_name: Django Management Commands & Investment Base Model
nodes.rationale: The watcher writes its heartbeat to the database (table core_watcher_heartbeat) instead of disk because the watcher and web server may run on separate machines without a shared filesystem (e.g. Railway worker + Render web). /healthz/watcher/ returns 503 if the heartbeat is missing or stale.

nodes.label: Render + Railway + Neon Free-Tier Deployment Topology
nodes.norm_label: render + railway + neon free-tier deployment topology
nodes.rationale: Free-tier topology for personal use: Render hosts the Gunicorn web app, Railway runs watch_tp_sl continuously as a worker, Neon provides pooled PostgreSQL. Both services must share identical security/DB environment variables; only the start command differs. DB_CONN_MAX_AGE=0 is kept because Neon suspends compute after inactivity.

nodes.label: Global Authorization Model (P1)
nodes.rationale: All business views use login_required, but models have no owner and querysets use objects.all(); any authenticated account can view, edit, delete all trades/API keys and trigger a LIVE order. Only acceptable if the instance is explicitly single-user; a multi-user instance needs an owner FK, per-queryset filtering, and object permissions.

nodes.label: AI Discipline Coach
nodes.rationale: Proposed assistant that helps the trader follow their own stated plan (pre-entry briefing, mid-position plan recall, post-close review, weekly synthesis) without acting as a signal provider or financial advisor. Must separate facts/calculations from model-generated suggestions, flag small samples, and never send secrets/API keys to the AI provider.

nodes.label: Coach IA as Independent Spin-off Product
nodes.norm_label: coach ia as independent spin-off product
nodes.rationale: Idea to separate the AI Discipline Coach from Tradiaries into an independent 'Trade Journal Intelligence' product connectable to Tradiaries or third-party CSV/API sources, widening the addressable market without waiting for Tradiaries to be fully production-ready.
